ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential consequences of the Trump administration's freeze on child care funding, including the impact on child care providers and families.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the freeze on child care funding?
How will the freeze affect child care providers and families?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story is important because it has the potential to impact thousands of families and child care providers. By investigating the potential consequences of the freeze, we can provide a more comprehensive understanding of the issue and its implications.
